summary: Passkey (WebAuthn) registration and login verified end-to-end on the preview URL using a CDP Virtual Authenticator (ctap2, internal, resident key, user verified). Both /api/webauthn/register/options + /register/verify and /api/webauthn/login/options + /login/verify returned 200, a JWT was persisted to localStorage 'promethius_token' (len=165 for both), and the app navigated from /login to '/' after each flow. No 'Unexpected client data origin' error occurred — the origin allowlist fix (WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN now a list including the preview URL) is working. The user-reported bug is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>1400 lines shown, likely more). Consider splitting into modules (auth/webauthn, chat, files, github, tools) for maintainability.

webauthn_login_verify looks up the credential by req.credential.get('id') which is the client-side base64url id — this is compared against stored credential_id_b64. Ensure both use the same URL-safe base64 (no padding) format. Currently working, but a helper to normalize would harden it.

WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN includes localhost defaults even in cloud preview. Harmless (webauthn library just checks membership), but for production hardening consider gating base localhost origins behind a DEV flag.
test_credentials: Test user created dynamically: qa_passkey_1785837054@example.com (passkey stored in ephemeral virtual authenticator; not reusable across sessions).
seed_data_creation: One user + one passkey credential created in DB during this test (email above).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebAuthn passkey flow works on the preview URL. To retest, you MUST inject a Playwright/CDP Virtual Authenticator BEFORE navigating: cdp.send('WebAuthn.enable') then 'WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator' with {protocol:'ctap2', transport:'internal', hasResidentKey:true, hasUserVerification:true, isUserVerified:true, automaticPresenceSimulation:true}. Reuse the SAME page (same authenticator) for register→login. Use a fresh email per run because credentials in the DB persist. Backend .env keys WEBAUTHN_RP_ID and WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN are set to the preview host.
rca of the issue: Root cause was that backend passed a single string to py_webauthn's expected_origin, so only one origin was accepted; the browser sent the preview URL as clientDataJSON.origin which did not match. Fix: WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN is now built as a de-duplicated list ([localhost:3000, localhost:8001, 127.0.0.1 variants, plus each origin in the WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN env var]). py_webauthn 3.x accepts a list and matches if origin is a member. Verified in preview: no 'Unexpected client data origin' error appeared and both verify endpoints returned 200 + token.
